message.content: Use proxy:solo. Add weekLabel(startDate) to the reports module so the weekly summary heading shows the week range.

content.text:
solo: no questions, plan mode auto-approves, every decision is mine. Interrupt anytime to steer.

The build plan is approved and I am implementing it now. Decisions so far: weekLabel(startDate, options) takes a locale option and a format option with three presets; formatted labels are memoised in a small cache keyed by date and locale; the summary builder passes the user's locale through. Tests for all three presets come next, then the post-build review and the QA plan.
